ADMIN_USERNAME.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username for hexo-admin and the /terminal/ basic-auth gate.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for hexo-admin and the /terminal/ basic-auth gate.

ARTALK_SITE_URL.name: ARTALK_SITE_URL
ARTALK_SITE_URL.description: Public URL of the Artalk comment service (auto-derived from the comments service's public domain).

MINIO_ENDPOINT.name: MINIO_ENDPOINT
MINIO_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint for the storage service (auto-derived from its public domain). Enables S3-backed image uploads from the editor.

MINIO_BUCKET.name: MINIO_BUCKET
MINIO_BUCKET.description: Bucket where editor-uploaded images are stored (auto-created on first upload).

MINIO_ACCESS_KEY.name: MINIO_ACCESS_KEY
MINIO_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 access key for the storage service (shared from storage.MINIO_ROOT_USER).

MINIO_SECRET_KEY.name: MINIO_SECRET_KEY
MINIO_SECRET_KEY.description: S3 secret key for the storage service (shared from storage.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD).
